title: Give honest opinion and advice. Working on this phone roguelike game, and this is the result. Was nervous to post this, but here we go
author: 6Moon9
selftext: Hey guys, I have been working on this game for few weeks, it took alot of time to get the models and vfx to fit abit, even tho they are still not fitting much. This is my first try, and I hope you can give me your honest opinion abt it. Thanks ❤️

comments.author: Early_Flamingo5337
comments.body: It does look ok, although the gameplay does not seem very original. No offense, but what will make people play it over other, more polished, same style games?

replies.author: 6Moon9
replies.body: No offense taken :) its the whole point of the post, to learn more. Thanks for your point tho!

comments.author: First_Act3728
comments.body:
Looks very basic and unoriginal. The assets/style look like a poor ripoff of Clash Royale. Style is bad (menus/popups especially), no juice (look it up), asset pop-in, and even poor cleanup on the 2d assets. 

Gameplay looks whatever... Survivors-likes aren't fun just because they're a survivors game, they're fun especially for their style and originality. Think of all the biggest ones - what do they have that your game lacks?

You need to work on some ideas for original style and/or gameplay

replies.author: 6Moon9
replies.body: Thanks for your honest opinion, I honestly think its not original as well. Felt abit hard to create my own art style with the AI, but can try to change that and see what style/theme i can use. Thanks again!

comments.author: Silver-Second-647
comments.body:
https://reddit.com/link/phl287f/video/7wkqbihhwawh1/player

First of all, the characters are adorable! 😂

I really like how consistent the art style feels across the characters and the environment. Everything fits together nicely, especially for a first game!

While watching, I couldn't help thinking that some sound effects could make the little battles feel even more alive, so I went ahead and made a version with sound haha.

Hope you don't mind me sharing it here! I'd love to know what you think! 🔊

replies.author: 6Moon9
replies.body: Haha thanks for that, i know it could be better tho! We actually have sounds but stupid me forgot to unmute while recording 😂 your sounds are great tho😄

replies.author: Silver-Second-647
replies.body:
Hahahaha, that explains it! 😂

I thought the game was still waiting for its sound effects, so I couldn't resist adding some!

Glad you liked my version though! I'd love to hear your original sounds too, especially with those adorable little characters haha.

Keep up the great work!!!!!

comments.author: starcount_games
comments.body: Looks okay, overall with polished mechanics will be probably fun to play. Make sure to add more identity to your game. Art need polish in terms of backgorund images look cluttred.

comments.author: Smecje
comments.body: I feel like so many of these games are the same. Its great youre building somethinf but from the art and mechanics I feel like I get the same games on my feed everyday.

comments.author: Sufficient_Try8335
comments.body: The shadows need a change, maybe a different angle from the light? Fun start

comments.author: Saytron3030
comments.body: How do you allow that circle to sit over the character sprite before you did any other polish lol
